aq_keeper.text: This hall opened in 1872. Granite columns, a vaulted roof, and the oldest aquarium still working anywhere in the world.
The local seas are richer than people think: cuttlefish, seahorses, thornback rays, and once a year a few dolphins showing off past the pier.
Our turtle's called Lulu. She arrived with a bad flipper. She's been here so long she's practically staff.

aq_child.text: A seahorse dad has the babies! In a pouch! My dad says he's not doing that.
